summary: Join our training on Communities of Practice and Social Learning Networks. Learn to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing in your professional community.
lede: Communities of practice and social learning networks provide a structured way to turn shared expertise into ongoing team learning. This training is for professionals who create, manage, or enable learning and knowledge sharing, including L&D, knowledge management, project, and change teams. It covers defining community purpose and roles, facilitating participation, capturing reusable knowledge, and assessing engagement and value.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who create, manage, or enable learning and knowledge sharing:
audience: HR leaders, L&D managers, and capability builders
Communities of Practice coordinators and knowledge champions
modules: Measuring Value and Telling the Story
